title: hydrocotyle hookeri
intro: Hydrocotyle hookeri, commonly known as Indian pennywort or hooker's water pennywort, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Araliaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving cognitive function, and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Hydrocotyle hookeri are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic agent. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess anti-stress, anti-fatigue, and antioxidant activities.
